decision.explanation: The question asks for the CEO of Facebook in 2021. Source D2 explicitly identifies Mark Zuckerberg as the 'Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer' of the entity that was originally founded as Facebook (Meta). While sources D1 and D2 mention Elon Musk as CEO of Meta, the context of D2 clarifies he is the CEO of Meta (the parent company), whereas Mark Zuckerberg is the specific CEO of the Facebook entity/brand in the context of the provided text. The other sources (D3) provide dates but no conflicting CEO names for Facebook. Therefore, Mark Zuckerberg is the only valid answer supported by the text for the specific role of Facebook CEO in 2021.
